newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA FEB PRODUCER PRICES UP 129.4 PCT MTH/MTH.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA FEB PRODUCER PRICES UP 129.4 PCT MTH/MTH.

text.p: Bulgaria's producer price inflation in February was 129.4 percent month on month and 1,500.9 percent year on year, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIAN PRODUCER PRICES FEB JAN FEB'96
"The sharp lev fall in February boosted prices of imported
raw materials and fuels on which Bulgaria's economy is strongly
dependent," an NSI official told Reuters.
The lev hit a record low of 3,200 per dollar in the first
week of February before rebounding to around 2,000 at the end
of the month. It traded near 600 at the beginning of the year.
